statement: For exactly two actual global quotient partitions, the full lifted local centralizer is classified in every C45 domain. In the plane it is the product of the two real target centralizers, each exactly the identity, integer translations or real translations; the actual downstairs group is this product modulo the retained source deck group. In the half-plane it is trivial. In the band it is generated by e(x,y)=(y,x+1), with source deck subgroup trivial or generated by an even power; the final local-centralizer quotient is the open Mobius band. The complete quotient table isolates every noncocompact case as a plane, open cylinder, line or open Mobius band with lifted group 1, Z or R.
depends_on: C30 actual free proper centralizer topology; C42-C45 global quotient covers and exact coordinate domains; C46 coordinate-pair or exchange comparison; C48 real-line centralizer classification and topology of all lifts; C49 compact-word/source-deck transitivity argument; C53 full global family; C55 local normalizer equation and actual full local centralizer

depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. Every source deck group and quotient map is retained. A coordinate exchange in the plane is excluded by an explicit invariant graph; decreasing coordinate functions are excluded by the fixed-point and transitive-centralizer argument.
notes: In the full plane, every lifted local centralizer element preserves the two-partition family. A swap would intertwine the two target representations and preserve the graph of that intertwiner, contradicting source transitivity. The remaining coordinate factors lie in the full real target centralizers. Those factors are abelian, so every such pair commutes with the original source deck subgroup and descends, proving equality rather than just inclusion. The actual downstairs topology follows from the previously proved covering comparison for maps and inverses. The final orbit quotient is identified by the two open quotient maps from the same source. Half-plane ordered-pair transitivity makes the target point stabilizer fix only that point, killing every commuting diagonal map; increasing swaps violate the half-plane inequality and decreasing swaps cannot centralize a transitive line group. In the band the point stabilizer fixes exactly x+Z, proving that the unit period is primitive. All lifts are powers of e, orientation forces source decks to be even powers, and the coordinates (x+y,y-x-1/2) give the exact glide-reflection quotient. This classification supplies no new frontier contraction; C12 remains Open.
computational_checks: The coordinate maps, inverses and quotient actions are verified directly by the displayed identities; no numerical computation is used.
